---
title: Final Self-Assessment Reflection
---

Answer the following questions about your learning and participation across the whole semester. I am not expecting extensive essays — some questions may be answered in a sentence, while others may inspire more detail.

1. What have you done to ensure that you understand the material and concepts in this course?
1. How have you addressed previous goals, challenges, and/or feedback over the course of the semester?
1. How has your understanding of organizations and communication changed since the start of the semester? Point to specific concepts or moments that shifted your thinking.
1. How did working on your final project — analyzing your own organization — change how you see it?
1. What have you learned in this class that you will carry with you into your own life?
1. What obstacles have you overcome this semester?
1. What else would you like to share?

---

Next, look back through Brightspace and Discord and review the work you've done across the semester. Think as well about your participation in Tuesday discussions, Thursday case studies, and your reading reviews. Also review the grade-level descriptions in the [syllabus](/syllabus/syllabus.qmd#grades).

* Based on your answers above, the work you have done, and the grade-level descriptions in the syllabus, what grade would you assign yourself for the course? Why?

---

Finally, some feedback for me:

* What did you enjoy most about this class?
* What are two ways in which this class could be better?

Feel free to share this feedback anonymously at [this link](https://forms.gle/ZQbTXHiaqy7WrxFj7) if you prefer.
